purpose: Criminal-first, non-fragmented provenance ledger joining formal RedSARA/AGE filings, later Ministerio Fiscal email communications and prosecutor-side responses without collapsing their evidential meaning.
governing_rules: A RedSARA/AGE receipt proves presentation/receipt only to its stated extent; it is not a merits finding or proof of investigation.
A sent email is not a formal RedSARA filing unless separately supported by a registration receipt.
A draft is not delivery and is excluded from sent/received denominators.
A self-archive is provenance/control material, not delivery to an authority.
An incoming acknowledgement, notice, decree or routing message is a response-side event and must not be counted as a claimant filing.
Duplicate or corrected transmissions preserve provenance but must identify the controlling version so they do not inflate substantive-event counts.
No final post-21-June denominator is asserted until the later RedSARA register and email/event corpus are deduplicated and status-reconciled.
